name: eink-usage-tracker
description: Track Codex AI usage and push stats to e-ink dashboard. Monitors token consumption, reasoning tokens, tool calls, and per-model breakdowns across sessions.
author: einktodo

hooks.description: Collect token usage after each Codex response

instructions:
This plugin tracks your Codex usage and pushes stats to an e-ink dashboard.

Setup:
1. Set EINKTODO_API_KEY in your environment
2. Optionally set EINKTODO_API_URL (default: einktodo.com)

Usage data is saved to ~/.codex/eink-usage-stats.json
Stats are pushed to the e-ink API after each session turn.
